text:
mike: Heads up — p95 apiserver jumped to ~1.2s in eu-west1 right after a GPU pool scale-up at ~12:03 UTC. Seeing stream errors and a bunch of 503s.
jen: Which control-plane nodes are affected? leader rotated?
arjun: Could be conntrack exhaustion from the burst of pod onboarding on the new GPU nodes. Any conntrack stats?
sasha: Pulling conntrack now, running:
```
sudo conntrack -S | grep entries
```
shows tcp entries ~124k on cp-04 (very high).
jen: Also seeing apiserver FD usage climb near 32k on cp-04. `ss -s` shows lots of TIME_WAIT/half-open sockets.
mike: We tried scaling down one of the new GPU nodes and p95 dropped to ~200ms within 90s.
oncall-bot: @channel incident-note created INC-2026-345 — paging oncall.
arjun: Short-term: bump nf_conntrack_max on control-plane nodes and reduce established timeout? risky but gives headroom.
sasha: Quick mitigation: apply sysctl bump via a DaemonSet to cp nodes (nf_conntrack_max -> 262144). Can do now.
jen: Also controller-manager leader-election jitter looks low. Current flags: `--leader-elect-lease-duration=15s` — might be too tight during churn. Consider increasing to 45s and tuning renewDeadline.
mike: Changing leader-elect values requires a controller-manager rollout which triggers elections; do a canary first.
arjun: Immediate relief idea: cordon the newly provisioned GPU nodes to stop onboarding traffic and let conntrack drain.
sasha: Cordon+drain in progress for the two most recent GPU nodes.
mike: p95 back down to baseline ~180–220ms after ~2 minutes of cordoning. Looks correlated.
jen: Action list: 1) sysctl bump DS (sasha) 2) controller-manager canary with longer lease (mike+arjun) 3) postmortem and cost impact note (jen).  Also flag that rapid auto-scale caused extra GPU spend during the incident.
deploy-bot: deployment/controller-manager-canary started (rev 42 -> 43) in eu-west1
sasha: Sysctl DS applied on cp-03/04/05, confirmed nf_conntrack_max=262144 on all.
mike: Keep the new GPU nodes cordoned until controller-manager canary stabilizes. Great quick ops. :thumbsup:
jen: I'll own the postmortem. Please drop any logs/metrics into the incident.
arjun: I'll add kube-proxy conntrack dumps and apiserver /metrics scrape output to the incident.
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-345 marked mitigated
